alpha_contract.admission: L3_DUAL_FRESH only: age<=90 and cumulative turnover<=same board/fold expanding TRAIN-only q66.67
alpha_contract.target: frozen primary-layer U legal T+1-or-later fill

portfolio.combined: fixed 50% Main sleeve plus 50% ChiNext sleeve with no capital transfer

metric_semantics.signals: all frozen Dual Fresh candidates before duplicate-position/capacity handling
metric_semantics.executed_trades: positions admitted into the sleeve, including positions still active at 2021-12-31
metric_semantics.capacity_skip: otherwise admissible signal rejected solely because active positions already equal K
metric_semantics.natural_concurrency: unlimited-slot chronological replay with one-active-symbol rule; daily positions are end-of-day active counts
metric_semantics.utilization: daily marked gross exposure divided by same-sleeve NAV
metric_semantics.top_pnl_contribution: share of total positive daily or completed-trade PnL contributed by the largest positive observations
metric_semantics.max_drawdown_duration: sessions from the prior NAV peak through the MaxDD trough

development_decision.material_cagr_improvement: candidate combined CAGR minus K20 combined CAGR >= 1.00 percentage point
development_decision.acceptable_drawdown: combined MaxDD no worse than -10% and no more than 5.00 points worse than K20
development_decision.no_catastrophic_day: largest combined one-day NAV loss no worse than -3%
development_decision.chronology: at least four of five combined calendar years positive
development_decision.board_interpretability: Main and ChiNext stitched total returns both positive
development_decision.k5_preferred: K5 qualifies, exceeds K10 CAGR by >=0.50 point, and MaxDD is no more than 2.00 points worse than K10
development_decision.k10_preferred: K10 qualifies and K5 does not satisfy k5_preferred
development_decision.capitalization_ready: K5 and K10 both qualify, their CAGR difference is <0.50 point, and K10 is retained as the less concentrated freeze
development_decision.concentration_too_high: a candidate clears material CAGR but fails acceptable drawdown or no-catastrophic-day
development_decision.does_not_solve: neither K5 nor K10 clears material CAGR
